sortieMusters.line: ⚔️ SORTIE — Norman, Ivy take up arms and a day's rations (4,055 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
⚔️ SORTIE — Dale, Lilia take up arms and a day's rations (2,773 kcal from the stores) and walk out to the treeline. Nobody's coming back the same.
